title: Rabbi Binyamin bar Giddel
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Chullin 125a he spoke in Rabbi Yochanan’s name. At the beginning of Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot, chapter 1, he and Rabbi Acha were sitting and disagreeing about the words of Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Chanina. In Jerusalem Talmud Maaserot 1:6, folio 4a: “Rabbi Ila in the name of Rabbi Yasa — Rabbi Binyamin bar Giddel objected.” He is likewise mentioned at the beginning of Jerusalem Talmud Terumot, chapter 9. Hyman infers from this that he belonged to the fourth generation of Palestinian Amoraim.

notes.text: The consulted Chullin 125a names Binyamin bar Giddel reporting Rabbi Yochanan. Hyman’s fourth-generation placement remains his inference.
